sources.title: FlashAttention-4: Algorithm and Kernel Pipelining Co-Design for Asymmetric Hardware Scaling
sources.claim: On B200 BF16, hardware-aware pipeline and softmax co-design reports up to 1.3x over cuDNN 9.13, 2.7x over Triton, and 71% utilization.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Treat attention as a whole-pipeline scheduling problem; tune MMA, memory movement, softmax, and tile shape together per architecture.

sources.title: Nautilus: An Auto-Scheduling Tensor Compiler for Efficient Tiled GPU Kernels
sources.claim: Automated successive lowering reports up to 23% over SOTA compilers on GH200 and 42% on RTX 5090 across 150 configurations.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Replace environment-variable tile selection with a persistent, correctness-constrained per-device and per-shape autotuning database.

sources.title: VDCores: Resource Decoupled Programming and Execution for Asynchronous GPU
sources.claim: Dependency-driven micro-operations report 24% average and up to 77% dynamic-input decode throughput improvement across GH200, H100, and RTX 6000 Pro.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Evolve streams toward explicit dependency graphs that overlap copy, tensor, reduction, and communication engines.

sources.title: Introducing NVFP4 for Efficient and Accurate Low-Precision Inference
sources.claim: NVFP4 uses 16-value micro-block scaling and reports 3.5x lower model memory than FP16, 1.8x lower than FP8, with under 1% degradation on selected tasks.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Add native block-scaled FP4 storage, conversion, GEMM, calibration, and quality evidence on eligible Blackwell devices.

sources.title: Metal Feature Set Tables
sources.claim: Metal tensor resources expose block-scaled 2-bit, 4-bit, and 8-bit formats, including MetalFloat4E2M1 and FP8 formats, with explicit alignment contracts.
sources.tensorcore_implication: The Apple backend must detect tensor-format support at runtime and benchmark native MTLTensor/MPP paths against simdgroup fallbacks.

sources.title: hipBLASLt documentation
sources.claim: AMD's current flexible matmul library is the production comparison and integration surface for tuned ROCm GEMM.
sources.tensorcore_implication: HIP performance claims require same-shape comparisons against current hipBLASLt and recorded solution-selection metadata.

sources.title: RCCL documentation
sources.claim: RCCL provides optimized multi-GPU and multi-node collectives over PCIe and xGMI and exposes tuner and network plugin surfaces.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Use RCCL as the AMD-native fast path while preserving TensorCore's portable and failure-aware collective contract.

sources.title: DeepEP: an efficient expert-parallel communication library
sources.claim: DeepEP V2 targets high-throughput and low-latency MoE all-to-all with FP8, NCCL Gin, analytical resource sizing, and domains up to EP2048.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Add expert dispatch/combine as first-class collective shapes and measure SM occupation, link goodput, skew, and tail latency.

sources.title: Mooncake: A KVCache-centric Disaggregated Architecture for LLM Serving
sources.claim: KV-aware prefill/decode scheduling reports 20-40% gains on public long-context datasets and 75% more served requests on a real trace while meeting SLOs.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Model KV blocks, locality, transfer cost, TTFT, and inter-token latency in scheduling rather than treating remote memory as an unpriced tensor fetch.

sources.title: NVIDIA Dynamo Disaggregated Serving
sources.claim: Disaggregation is workload-dependent and KV transfer is critical; without a fast transfer path, colocated serving can be faster.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Make disaggregation admission depend on measured link, KV layout compatibility, and an aggregated same-workload baseline.

sources.title: vLLM Speculative Decoding
sources.claim: Current vLLM exposes EAGLE, MTP, draft, n-gram, suffix, and dynamic speculation with workload-dependent benefits and reproducible benchmark guidance.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Benchmark lossless speculative paths by QPS regime and acceptance rate; never assume a draft method improves high-load throughput.

sources.title: NVIDIA NCCL Documentation
sources.claim: NCCL 2.30 is topology-aware and supports collective execution across threads, processes, and machines.
sources.tensorcore_implication: NVIDIA collective claims require NCCL comparisons and captured GPU-NIC/PCIe/NVLink topology, not rank count alone.

sources.title: Kubernetes Dynamic Resource Allocation
sources.claim: Stable DRA models accelerator attributes, claims, sharing, health, and placement; newer APIs add partitionable devices, consumable capacity, and device taints.
sources.tensorcore_implication: The topology authority must expose typed capabilities, allocatable capacity, health/taints, leases, and link-local placement constraints.

sources.title: SPIFFE Workload API
sources.claim: The stable workload API defines process-bound X.509 and JWT identities with streamed rotation and trust-bundle updates.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Bind every transport peer to a short-lived workload identity and make rotation and mixed-version failure part of the protocol tests.

sources.title: Tailscale tailnet policy syntax
sources.claim: Tailscale recommends deny-by-default grants, role tags, device posture, and checked policy tests for new access-control configurations.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Use grants and policy tests as the network authorization layer while retaining application-level authenticated peer identity.

sources.title: MLPerf Inference Rules
sources.claim: Comparable system results require shared implementations, fixed system/framework definitions, quality and latency constraints, and mandatory replicability.
sources.tensorcore_implication: Publish machine-readable system manifests, quality runs, load traces, latency distributions, power, and open reproduction commands with every frontier claim.

gates.comparator: same model, weights, quality target, hardware class, request trace, and power boundary
gates.pass_condition: Every public system claim has a checked manifest, quality result, p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, energy, five or more repetitions, and one-command reproduction.
gates.evidence: versioned JSON result bundle plus raw logs and environment manifest

gates.metric: geometric-mean latency across the fleet shape matrix
gates.comparator: best correct static TensorCore kernel selected by exhaustive offline sweep
gates.pass_condition: Runtime selection is within 5% of the offline best on at least 95% of shapes and improves geometric-mean latency by at least 10% over the current static defaults.
gates.evidence: device-fingerprint tuning database, correctness hashes, cold/warm timings, and held-out shape results

gates.metric: attention forward/backward latency and achieved bandwidth/compute
gates.comparator: current vendor or official implementation on the identical device, dtype, mask, sequence, and head shape
gates.pass_condition: Beat the public baseline by at least 5% on one fleet-relevant Pareto point with no greater than 3% regression across the required shape matrix and matched numerical tolerances.
gates.evidence: same-process A/B harness, profiler counters, correctness outputs, and raw timing distributions
gates.blocker: CUDA WMMA/Blackwell and D=128 measurements plus same-hardware official baselines are incomplete.

gates.metric: end-to-end memory, latency, energy, and task-quality Pareto frontier
gates.comparator: BF16/FP16 and current vendor-native FP8/FP4 paths on the same model and hardware
gates.pass_condition: Deliver at least 1.5x lower model-plus-KV memory or 1.25x higher throughput with no more than 1% relative quality loss and no tail-latency regression.
gates.evidence: calibration recipe, model quality suite, memory accounting, power trace, and end-to-end serving results
gates.blocker: Native block-scaled FP4/FP8 compute and model-quality evidence are not implemented across eligible backends.

gates.metric: end-to-end tokens per joule and kernel latency on Apple9/Apple10-class devices
gates.comparator: current TensorCore simdgroup path and current official Apple/MLX path on the same machine
gates.pass_condition: Native MTLTensor/MPP dispatch is proven and wins a Pareto point by at least 5% without correctness or supported-shape regression.
gates.evidence: runtime capability trace, native-path assertion, model quality, power, and same-host A/B results
gates.blocker: Physical M4/M5 family selection and Metal 4 tensor-operation evidence remain incomplete.

gates.metric: GEMM and collective latency across representative MI-series hardware
gates.comparator: current hipBLASLt and RCCL on identical shapes and topology
gates.pass_condition: TensorCore matches within 5% where delegating and exceeds a baseline Pareto point by 5% where a custom path is retained, with all solution and topology metadata captured.
gates.evidence: physical HIP runner results, selected solution IDs, RCCL topology, correctness, and raw timings
gates.blocker: Representative physical ROCm runtime and performance evidence are absent.

gates.metric: MoE dispatch/combine goodput, p99 latency, skew tolerance, and compute-engine occupancy
gates.comparator: DeepEP or vendor collective baseline supported by the tested accelerator/fabric
gates.pass_condition: Reach at least 85% of measured usable link bandwidth, preserve p99 under declared expert skew, and consume no more compute resources than the best supported baseline.
gates.evidence: token-routing trace, skew sweep, topology manifest, link counters, profiler occupancy, and failure recovery
gates.blocker: The active cross-node fleet path is 1 GbE and lacks the RDMA-class fabric needed for a credible DeepEP comparison.

gates.metric: SLO-qualified request goodput with TTFT and inter-token latency
gates.comparator: aggregated serving on the same total accelerators, model, trace, and quality target
gates.pass_condition: Enable remote prefill/decode only when it improves SLO-qualified goodput by at least 15%, preserves p99 inter-token latency, and the live KV-transfer model predicts the measured result within 10%.
gates.evidence: aggregated/disaggregated A/B run, KV hit-rate and transfer trace, link probe, rejection accounting, and failure test
gates.blocker: The measured Atlas-cosbox path is about 103 MB/s; local storage currently beats remote paging.

gates.metric: accepted tokens per verification, p99 inter-token latency, and throughput by offered QPS
gates.comparator: non-speculative TensorCore and current vLLM method on the same target/draft models and sampling configuration
gates.pass_condition: Improve p99 inter-token latency by at least 15% in a declared QPS regime without output-distribution or high-QPS throughput regression.
gates.evidence: acceptance trace, deterministic greedy equality, distribution test, QPS sweep, and end-to-end power results

gates.metric: collective goodput, p99 completion, scaling efficiency, and recovery time by topology class
gates.comparator: NCCL/RCCL when available and centralized TensorCore rank-zero implementation
gates.pass_condition: Match vendor libraries within 10% on homogeneous islands, beat centralized TensorCore by 2x beyond four ranks, bound state, and recover or fail closed within the declared timeout after one peer loss.
gates.evidence: topology capture, size/rank sweep, concurrent-ordering test, memory-bound trace, and injected peer failure

gates.metric: eligible-resource coverage, inventory freshness, placement validity, and lease recovery
gates.comparator: computer_mesh plus every Tailscale profile and cloud inventory
gates.pass_condition: Represent 100% of eligible devices and links with typed capabilities, health/taints, allocatable capacity, identity, and freshness; reject stale or topology-invalid placement and recover expired leases automatically.
gates.evidence: signed topology snapshot, reconciliation diff, admission decisions, taint test, and lease-failure trace

gates.metric: authenticated peer coverage, rotation continuity, and unauthorized-connection rejection
gates.pass_condition: Every distributed TensorCore process presents a short-lived workload identity bound to protocol role and topology identity; rotation is zero-downtime and all unknown, expired, replayed, wrong-role, and mixed-version peers fail closed.
gates.evidence: mTLS/JWT-SVID handshake trace, Tailscale grant tests, rotation test, and negative-path matrix

gates.metric: quality-constrained throughput, TTFT, inter-token latency, energy, memory, and recovery across topology classes
gates.comparator: best reproducible public or vendor baseline available for each identical topology class
gates.pass_condition: Hold at least one statistically significant Pareto lead on every eligible backend class and one end-to-end fleet workload, with no unsupported blanket cross-hardware claim.
gates.evidence: fleet acceptance matrix, raw result bundles, source revisions, confidence intervals, and independent replay
gates.blocker: Topology reconciliation, hardware proof, native dispatch, and distributed scale gates are not yet complete.
